notes.title: Street Outlaws: The List - Update v1.02
notes.content:
Start your engines and get ready for the update! In this update we fix the most heard feedback from our community.
We hope you enjoy the update and that it will improve your experience as you are challenging the 405.
The Street Outlaws: The List team

This update contains the following improvements:

[b]Gameplay adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Level 50 is now displayed as "Max"
[*] Increased drag stripes for Farmlands environments
[*] Last gameplay camera option selected now gets saved and does not reset
[/list]

[b]Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem with returning to the main menu from the garage
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[i]Quickplay:[/i]
[list]
[*] All unlocked cars are available
[*] All cars of the same tier now have the same performance
[*] Player can now select a car tier
[/list]

[i]Garage:[/i]
[list]
[*] Free look camera added
[/list]

[i]General:[/i]
[list]
[*] Possibility to delete the saved game from Options Menu
[/list]
